title: Limits, quotas and abuse
purpose: Show the per-tenant session quota, the hard session end time, the namespace quota and limits, and that a runaway process is contained inside its own sandbox.

checks.description: a tenant's fourth concurrent session is refused cleanly with 429
checks.because: The Manager counts a tenant's active claims against its limit of three.

checks.description: another tenant is not affected by that limit
the claim, and with it the sandbox, was deleted when its end time passed, with nobody asking
checks.because: shutdownTime with shutdownPolicy Delete is set on the claim; the controller enforces it.

checks.description: asking for 2.5 GiB inside a 1 GiB sandbox was stopped by the memory limit (the abuser's container was restarted)
checks.because: The pod's memory limit is enforced by the guest kernel's cgroup, inside the microVM.

checks.description: the neighbouring sandbox on the same node was not touched
checks.because: Each sandbox has its own kernel and its own memory.
The microVM boundary kept the failure inside the guest.

notes: TTL test: a session with a 45 second lifetime is created and left alone.
